It's been just over a month since R. was awarded Security Consultant of the Year at the New Zealand Security Association, and we're still proud of what this achievement represents.
Combined with Shamal Kumar's recognition as a finalist, it highlights the depth of talent across the Red Wolf team and our commitment to delivering great outcomes for our clients.
Thanks NZSA, Gary Morrison, Lucy Nichols, Tacia Strawbridge, and everyone else involved in making this incredible event possible.
Well done again, team.

The day started with fantastic news! I’m proud to share that Shamal Kumar and I have been selected as finalists for the New Zealand Security Association Awards.
​A h-u-g-e thank you to our incredible team at Red Wolf High Level Security and the executive at ASIS New Zealand for enabling me to do my work.
​More than anyone else, I want to thank my partner, Jay R. , for helping me become a better person on both a personal and professional level.
​
Congrats to Shamal and all the other finalists. Looking forward to the awards night!
